    # Step 1: Try to locate the search bar on the current page using accessibility tree-centric selectors
    search_bar = None

    if await page.get_by_role('searchbox').count() > 0:

        search_bar = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Search').first
    elif await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='search').count() > 0:
        search_bar = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='search').first
    # Check for combobox with name containing 'Search'
    elif await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Search').count() > 0:
        search_bar = page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Search').first
    elif await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='search').count() > 0:
        search_bar = page.get_by_role('combobox', name='search').first
    # If search bar not found, navigate to homepage via the 'Epoch & Drift Benchmark' link
    if search_bar is None:
        await page.get_by_role('link', name='Epoch & Drift Benchmark').click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        # Retry finding search bar on the new page
        if await page.get_by_role('searchbox').count() > 0:
            search_bar = page.get_by_role('searchbox').first
        elif await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Search').count() > 0:
            search_bar = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Search').first
        elif await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='search').count() > 0:
            search_bar = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='search').first
        elif await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Search').count() > 0:
            search_bar = page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Search').first
        elif await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='search').count() > 0:
            search_bar = page.get_by_role('combobox', name='search').first
        else:
            raise Exception('Search bar not found on the site')
    # Step 2: Fill the search bar with 'DeepSeek' and submit
    await search_bar.fill('DeepSeek')
    await search_bar.press('Enter')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Step 3: Identify search results using accessibility tree-centric selectors
    results = None
    # Try common result containers: articles, list items, or links
    if await page.get_by_role('article').count() > 0:
        results = page.get_by_role('article')
    elif await page.get_by_role('listitem').count() > 0:
        results = page.get_by_role('listitem')
    elif await page.get_by_role('link').count() > 0:
        # Use all links as results; in a real scenario, might need filtering, but task assumes possible
        results = page.get_by_role('link')
    else:
        raise Exception('No search results found')
    # Step 4: Click the bottom result (last one)
    result_count = await results.count()
    bottom_result = results.nth(result_count - 1)
    await bottom_result.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
